summary: The complete booze effect moves the first stop from step 241 to 263 without a prior screen or RNG mismatch. Confusion then reaches its final timed turn. timeout.c nh_timeout restores HConfusion to 1, calls make_confused(0, TRUE), and stops the occupation if confusion cleared; JavaScript has no expiry arm and refuses this property before the turn. This is missing source behavior in the partial nh_timeout implementation, not a planning-only divergence.
